objective: A frozen exact census of the 32,768 level laws on Z/3 into classes E (no solution), D (deterministic), A (a periodic solution with a branching pattern), WA (weakly aperiodic: solutions, no finite board) and P (periodic, branching only off the periodic solutions), each of WA and P with certificate L1, L2 or none (U); predictions C1 (no law is undecided) and C2 (the horofunction law is weakly aperiodic with certificate L2 and without L1).
title: Level laws on three values
